svg.aria-label: XML parsing throughput of existing implementations
svg.text: XML parsing: average speed relative to XmlBeef
geometric mean over the inputs both handled of each library's MB/s ÷ XmlBeef's · higher is better
No comparable figure (failed every input): Beef-Lang-XML, Xml-Beef
MB/s · the fastest library that builds a document and the fastest reader · bars scaled per input
* pugixml failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (leaves references to DTD-declared entities unexpanded); parse_default drops whitespace-only
text, so its text length is not compared.
* pugixml (ws_pcdata) failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (leaves references to DTD-declared entities unexpanded).
* JDK DOM failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (the JDK's default entity size limit).
* nektro/zig-xml trims spaces and newlines from both ends of every text run; text not compared.
* xmlquery failed SVG (Illustrator-style) and book, UTF-16 (cannot decode UTF-16 with a BOM).
* XmlParser failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (no DOCTYPE support); an editor's syntax tree that keeps the source text; only counts are
* xmltree failed SVG artwork (Inkscape), book (XHTML text) and book, UTF-16 (keys attributes by local name, so xml:lang and lang
* fast-xml-parser failed all but SVG icons (17k files), OpenStreetMap and Atom (namespaces) (leaves numeric character references
* xmlparser a tokenizer: values and text are raw spans, only counts are compared.
* JDK SAX failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (the JDK's default entity size limit).
* JDK StAX failed SVG (Illustrator-style) (the JDK's default entity size limit).
* BeefXml reader failed SVG artwork (Inkscape), SVG (Illustrator-style), book (XHTML text) and book, UTF-16 (no CDATA before text,
fetches the external DTD, wrong values); skips whitespace before every token; text not compared.
Linux x86-64, single thread · 1 s warm-up, then samples until 60% are within ±10% of their median · median of 3 processes · bench/compare
